title: Prognosis Without Prediction: The Intrinsic Geometry of Survival
abstract: arXiv:2611.24799v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Modeling systemic failure in high-dimensional environments is fundamentally limited by supervised algorithms that attempt to predict sparse, noisy or censored endpoints. To break this reliance on explicit outcome regression, we engineered the Self-Organizing Survival Manifolds (SOSM) framework, a deep learning architecture that decouples unsupervised representation learning from survival labels and treats time-to-event progression as an emergent geometric property. The system projects heterogeneous multi-omics arrays into a unified latent space governed by a pseudotime-weighted, curvature-minimizing graph Laplacian, organizing patient trajectories along low-dissipation geodesic flows. To validate the framework, we applied this architecture to a 184-patient clear cell renal cell carcinoma multi-omics cohort. translated_title: 无需预测的预后：生存的内在几何学
translated_abstract: 在高维环境中建模系统性失败，从根本上受限于那些试图预测稀疏、含噪或删失终点的监督式算法。为了打破这种对显式结局回归的依赖，我们构建了自组织生存流形（Self-Organizing Survival Manifolds, SOSM）框架，这是一种将无监督表示学习与生存标签解耦的深度学习架构，并将事件发生时间的进展视为一种涌现的几何属性。该系统将异构的多组学数据阵列投影到一个统一的潜在空间中，该空间由一个伪时间加权、曲率最小化的图拉普拉斯算子所支配，从而将患者轨迹组织成沿低耗散测地线流的路径。为验证该框架，我们将此架构应用于一个包含184名患者的透明细胞肾细胞癌多组学队列。在一个确定性的5折交叉验证流程中，SOSM取得了平均0.768 ± 0.068的一致性指数，同时其外部（截断处）……
tldr: 该论文提出自组织生存流形（SOSM）深度学习框架，通过将无监督表示学习与生存标签解耦，并借助伪时间加权、曲率最小化的图拉普拉斯潜空间把生存进展视为数据内在几何的涌现属性，从而在184例透明细胞肾细胞癌多组学队列上无需显式结局回归即实现了0.768±0.068的平均一致性指数。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes the Self-Organizing Survival Manifolds (SOSM) deep learning framework, which decouples unsupervised representation learning from survival labels and treats time-to-event progression as an emergent geometric property via a pseudotime-weighted, curvature-minimizing graph Laplacian latent space, achieving a mean Concordance Index of 0.768±0.068 on a 184-patient clear cell renal cell carcinoma multi-omics cohort without explicit outcome regression.
